verdict.reasons: Core defect: Mixed product family. The image displays the correct AFP tape roll in the foreground, but also features an installed rigid black hose running down the field. The rules strictly define observed_family by the presence of actual wrong commercial rolls/packages or, in this context, clear supporting infrastructure that is not the target product. The presence of the black supply hose alongside the target tape roll indicates a 'mixed' family. Additionally, the specific technical evidence of a 'continuous dark wet-soil strip' is not clearly visible; the soil uniformity and lighting make the wet/dry contrast indistinguishable.

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
